nodes.label: Conservation of migratory species

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Conservation of migratory species_qna_000
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: In how many European countries is the northern lapwing still hunted, according to the paragraph?
nodes.answer: The northern lapwing is still hunted in six European countries.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Conservation of migratory species_qna_001
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: Why is the migration of billions of birds significant?
nodes.answer: It has far-reaching consequences for conservation, ecosystem health, disease spread, aviation safety, and infrastructure development.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Conservation of migratory species_qna_002
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What percentage of bird species in western Mexico can migratory species represent?
nodes.answer: Migratory species can represent up to ~ 50% of the total bird species in western Mexico.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Conservation of migratory species_qna_003
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the geographical significance of Xalapa in relation to bird migration?
nodes.answer: Xalapa is considered one of the most important bird stopover sites due to its location along a major bird migration flyway between North and Central America and its position in the Nearctic-Neotropical transition zone.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Conservation of migratory species_qna_004
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: At the global scale, what specific issue is emphasized to change perspectives on movement?
nodes.answer: The specific issue emphasized is migration, particularly focusing on invasive species, to interpret the Earth as alive and made up of living beings.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Conservation of migratory species_qna_005
nodes.question: What is the purpose of the new multi-country collaboration mentioned in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: The purpose of the collaboration is to link international trade systems to social and environmental impacts in order to bend the curve of biodiversity loss at scale.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Conservation of migratory species_qna_006
nodes.question: What is the purpose of the multi-country collaboration mentioned in the text?
nodes.answer: The purpose of the multi-country collaboration is to link international trade systems to social and environmental impacts in order to bend the curve of biodiversity loss at scale.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Conservation of migratory species_qna_007
nodes.question: What are the implications of trade on biodiversity according to the UKRI GCRF report?
nodes.answer: The UKRI GCRF report discusses potential costs, benefits, and economic implications of the proposed 30% target for areal protection in the context of international trade and biodiversity protection.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Conservation of migratory species_qna_008
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: How does the proposed measure align with initiatives in neighboring countries?
nodes.answer: The proposed measure aligns with similar initiatives undertaken in neighboring countries, notably following the French model which imposes restrictions on short-distance flights where a train journey of less than 2.5 hours is available.
